intro.h2: A small local crew that answers its own phone
paragraphs: Your New Baths does bathroom remodeling in Boardman, OH and across Northeast Ohio and Western Pennsylvania, from Youngstown and Niles to New Castle. Most tub-to-shower conversions and shower replacements are finished in a single day, so your family is not without a bathroom for weeks.

Owner Brandon Moore is the name you see in nearly every review. He shows up on time, explains the plan for each day and cleans up before he leaves. Showers use Samuel Mueller solid surface panels, which are non-porous, so there are no grout lines to scrub. For bigger jobs, he also builds full tile showers with waterproofing behind every wall.

items.name: One-Day Tub to Shower Conversion
items.blurb: The old tub comes out and a low-threshold shower goes in, usually in a single day. Add a fold-down seat, a grab bar, corner shelves and a sliding glass door. It is a common pick for homeowners who want easier, safer footing in the bathroom.

image.alt: Tub to shower conversion in Lowellville, Ohio with marble-look walls, fold-down seat, grab bar and sliding glass door

items.name: Tub and Shower Replacement
items.blurb: Worn surrounds and dated tubs are replaced with Samuel Mueller solid surface walls. The color runs all the way through the material, so small scratches buff out, and the non-porous surface wipes clean without trapped moisture or hidden mold.

image.alt: Bathtub replacement with marble-look solid surface surround and sliding glass doors with black hardware

items.name: Custom Tile Showers
items.blurb: For homeowners who want tile, the crew does proper substrate prep, waterproofing and careful layout. A recent bathroom in Southington, Ohio got tile from floor to ceiling, waterproofing behind it all and a linear drain in the floor.

image.alt: Custom tile shower with large marble-look tile, a recessed niche, built-in corner bench and black shower valve

items.name: Full and Master Bath Remodels
items.blurb: Complete remodels cover the shower or tub plus flooring, vanities, lighting and plumbing fixtures, with the price set before work begins. These take longer than a one-day shower; one reviewer's full remodel was finished in 4 days, as promised.

image.alt: Remodeled walk-in shower with gold-veined marble-look walls, black rainfall shower head, glass doors and fold-down seat

about.h2: Meet Brandon Moore, founder and owner
about.text: Brandon Moore founded Your New Baths and still does the work himself. Google reviewers describe him the same way again and again: on time, quick, clear about the plan for each day, and careful to clean up. His company focuses on one-day showers and full bathroom transformations using Samuel Mueller solid surface materials, plus custom tile for clients who want it. Your New Baths is locally owned, licensed and insured, and the site says it has more than 10 years of experience serving Ohio homeowners. Jobs range from a surround shower in Niles to a full tile bath in Southington.

service_area.h2: Mahoning Valley, Greater Cleveland and Western PA
service_area.text: Your New Baths is based in Boardman and covers the Mahoning Valley and beyond. Its own list runs from Youngstown, Cortland and Champion north to Ashtabula and west to Akron, Cleveland, Solon and Chagrin Falls, plus New Castle across the line in Pennsylvania. Recent jobs and reviews also come from Niles, Lowellville and Southington. Call to check whether your town is on the schedule.

faq.h2: Before you book: common bath questions

items.q: Is it really done in one day?
items.a: Most tub-to-shower conversions and shower or tub replacements are finished in a single day, so you are not without a bathroom for long. Full and custom tile remodels take longer because they include flooring, vanities, plumbing and tile work. One Google reviewer's full remodel was completed in 4 days, exactly as promised.

The company's offer page says projects start at $8,500. Your exact price depends on the size of the space and the materials you pick, and you get a clear, upfront number at the free in-home estimate. That price is set before any work begins, with no gimmicks or surprise charges added later.

Yes. The site lists three plans: 12 months same as cash with no interest if paid in full, a 60-month plan at 8.99 percent from about $199 a month, and a 144-month plan at 9.99 percent from about $125 a month. Ask about financing at your free estimate; approval depends on credit.

items.q: Why solid surface instead of tile or acrylic?
items.a: Samuel Mueller solid surface is non-porous, so water cannot soak in, mold has nowhere to hide and soap scum wipes off. The color runs through the whole panel, so minor scratches can be buffed out. If you still prefer tile, Your New Baths builds custom tile showers with full waterproofing.

items.q: Can you fix a bathroom after water damage?
items.a: Yes. One Google reviewer in New Castle, PA hired Your New Baths after a burst pipe sent water into a basement bathroom. He praised the communication and said that once the work was done you couldn't tell anything had happened. Call to describe the damage and set up a visit.
